name: Death from Above
benefit:
Whenever you charge an opponent from higher ground, or from above while flying, you gain a +5 bonus on attack rolls in place of the bonuses from charging and being on higher ground.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 117
When charging an opponent from higher ground or from above while flying, you can spend 4 stamina points to gain a +5 bonus on the damage roll, and also retain the bonuses from charging and being on higher ground.
flavor: You allow gravity to add extra force to your charges.
